# PLAN — iteration 1

## Current state assessment
The seed passes the provided simulation and carries the required `// @latency 1` annotation, but routed setup WNS and register-to-register WNS are both −9.981 ns against a 6.667 ns clock period; hold slack is +0.171 ns. The advisory critical path chains five DSP48E1 stages and then carry logic across 16 levels, so timing closure is the first objective. No prior proposals have been tried.

## Hypothesis
Pairing symmetric FIR taps before summing the products may shorten the DSP cascade and improve setup WNS while keeping the same output cycle and arithmetic result.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the eight-sample delay line, reset behavior, output register, interface, parameter defaults, and `// @latency 1` unchanged. Replace the left-associated eight-product sum with four explicit pair sums for `(d[0]*C0 + d[7]*C7)`, `(d[1]*C1 + d[6]*C6)`, `(d[2]*C2 + d[5]*C5)`, and `(d[3]*C3 + d[4]*C4)`, then combine those pair results in a balanced tree into `y_out`. Preserve signed 16-bit parameter and sample semantics, Verilog expression sizing, and 32-bit output truncation for every supported parameter value; verify simulation and routed setup/hold before judging timing progress or closure.
